model SearchAutocompleteCache {
  id        String   @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  provider  String
  query     String
  response  Json
  createdAt DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  expiresAt DateTime @map("expires_at")

  @@unique([provider, query])
  @@index([expiresAt])
  @@map("search_autocomplete_cache")
}

/// Upstox BOD instruments — one row per instrument_key; derivative-only columns are nullable.
model Instrument {
  instrumentKey  String  @id @map("instrument_key")
  segment        String
  exchange       String
  instrumentType String  @map("instrument_type")
  tradingSymbol  String  @map("trading_symbol")
  name           String
  exchangeToken  String  @map("exchange_token")

  isin         String?
  shortName    String? @map("short_name")
  securityType String? @map("security_type")

  lotSize        Int?     @map("lot_size")
  freezeQuantity Decimal? @map("freeze_quantity") @db.Decimal
  tickSize       Decimal? @map("tick_size") @db.Decimal

  expiry           DateTime? @db.Timestamptz(6)
  strikePrice      Decimal?  @map("strike_price") @db.Decimal
  weekly           Boolean?
  minimumLot       Int?      @map("minimum_lot")
  underlyingSymbol String?   @map("underlying_symbol")
  underlyingKey    String?   @map("underlying_key")
  underlyingType   String?   @map("underlying_type")

  raw       Json     @db.JsonB
  updatedAt DateTime @default(now()) @updatedAt @map("updated_at") @db.Timestamptz(6)

  @@index([segment, instrumentType, tradingSymbol], map: "idx_instruments_symbol")
  @@index([name], map: "idx_instruments_name")
  @@index([shortName], map: "idx_instruments_short_name")
  @@map("instruments")
}

-- Upstox BOD instruments table (PostgreSQL)
-- One table for all instrument kinds; derivative-only columns are nullable.

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "instruments" (
    "instrument_key" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "segment" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "exchange" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "instrument_type" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "trading_symbol" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "name" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "exchange_token" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "isin" TEXT,
    "short_name" TEXT,
    "security_type" TEXT,
    "lot_size" INTEGER,
    "freeze_quantity" DECIMAL,
    "tick_size" DECIMAL,
    "expiry" TIMESTAMPTZ(6),
    "strike_price" DECIMAL,
    "weekly" BOOLEAN,
    "minimum_lot" INTEGER,
    "underlying_symbol" TEXT,
    "underlying_key" TEXT,
    "underlying_type" TEXT,
    "raw" JSONB NOT NULL,
    "updated_at" TIMESTAMPTZ(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,

    CONSTRAINT "instruments_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("instrument_key")
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "idx_instruments_symbol"
    ON "instruments"("segment", "instrument_type", "trading_symbol");

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "idx_instruments_name"
    ON "instruments"("name");

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "idx_instruments_short_name"
    ON "instruments"("short_name");

### Schema (`db/schema/schema.prisma`)

Added an `Instrument` model mapped to `instruments`, aligned with your SQL (nullable derivative/equity fields, `raw` JSONB, `updated_at`).

**Indexes:**
- `idx_instruments_symbol` — `(segment, instrument_type, trading_symbol)`
- `idx_instruments_name` — `(name)`
- `idx_instruments_short_name` — `(short_name)`

### Migration

`db/schema/migrations/20261010100000_upstox_instruments/migration.sql` — applied with `pnpm db:migrate:deploy`.

### Repository (`repositories/instrument.ts`)

| Function | Purpose |
|----------|---------|
| `getInstrumentByKey` | Primary-key lookup |
| `findInstrumentsByTradingSymbol` / `findInstrumentByTradingSymbol` | Symbol lookup (uses symbol index) |
| `searchInstrumentsByName` | Case-insensitive prefix on `name` |
| `searchInstrumentsByShortName` | Case-insensitive prefix on `short_name` |
| `searchInstrumentsByNameOrShortName` | Autocomplete-style OR search |
| `createInstrument`, `upsertInstrument`, `patchInstrument`, `upsertManyInstruments` | BOD ingest / updates |

Example:

```ts
import { searchInstrumentsByNameOrShortName } from "@/repositories/instrument";

const matches = await searchInstrumentsByNameOrShortName({
  query: "rel",
  segment: "NSE_EQ",
  limit: 10,
});
```
